import os
print(os.path.exists('/work/textmask.py'))
with open('/work/textmask.py') as f:
    print(f.read())

import importlib.util, re

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("textmask", "/work/textmask.py")
tm = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(tm)

def old_masked(text, name):
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split("-")), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r"\b" + re.escape(tok) + r"\b", "x", t)
    return t

cases = [
    ("Hello fowler-refactoring world", "fowler-refactoring"),
    ("FOWLER REFACTORING Fowler-Refactoring", "fowler-refactoring"),
    ("ab-cd short names ab cd", "ab-cd"),
    ("single", "single"),
    ("no-parts-match at all", "xyz-abc"),
    ("edge-case-of-same-length-tokens aa bb", "aa-bb"),
    ("", "name"),
    ("MixedCASE Name mixedcase name", "MixedCase-Name"),
]

all_ok = True
for text, name in cases:
    o = old_masked(text, name)
    n = tm.masked(text, name)
    ok = (o == n)
    all_ok &= ok
    print(repr(text), repr(name), "->", repr(o), repr(n), "OK" if ok else "MISMATCH")

# check name_tokens output directly
print(tm.name_tokens("fowler-refactoring"))
print(tm.name_tokens("single"))
print("ALL_OK:", all_ok)
